issue.detail: Spec does not define overlapping detection semantics (e.g., 1101101). Contract's S4 is terminal/latched, so after first detection no further matching occurs; alternative is to continue matching and re-detect, which would affect start_shifting only if reset clears it, but spec says forever until reset, so observable difference is only via reset timing.
issue.spec_evidence: searches for the sequence 1101 in an input bit stream
issue.alternative: After detecting 1101, remain in S4 and ignore further data until reset; start_shifting stays 1. Alternative: after detection, continue searching and allow re-detection, but start_shifting remains 1 until reset, so no observable difference unless reset occurs.
